stem: Which autism spectrum disorder red flag in a preschool child is best classified as a communication impairment?
explanation: Echolalia is the correct answer because it is a communication feature of autism spectrum disorder. It refers to repeating words or phrases spoken by others and is grouped with language and communication red flags rather than social interaction or restricted behaviour.

citations.source: Louisa Leone MD3 2025 - Child and Adolescent Health - Study Notes.pdf
citations.title: Louisa Leone MD3 2025 - Child and Adolescent Health - Study Notes.pdf p.83

optionExplanations.A: Incorrect because poor eye contact is more consistent with impairment in social interaction.
optionExplanations.B: Incorrect because no sharing of enjoyment is a social interaction red flag rather than a communication impairment.
optionExplanations.C: Correct because echolalia is a communication red flag in autism spectrum disorder and involves repeating words or phrases heard from others.
optionExplanations.D: Incorrect because spinning and twirling are restricted and repetitive behaviours.
optionExplanations.E: Incorrect because fixation on detail is a restricted pattern of interests or behaviour rather than a communication feature.
